name: Jimi na Kare to Watashi no Jijou
original_name: 地味なカレと私の事情
source:
You met your childhood friend, who's become quiet and plain, again at high school. But I's been a few month while being unable to talk to him....

One day, you and he were elected as entrants of a beauty contest by chance.

"It's going to be fine! Trust me!"

You decided to do a special training with him to win the contest!
What will he confess you when he's changed――?

[From Google Play store]
